text_block_list.text:
On the way back after watching a mock race 
together with Mayano Top Gun—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Maya-chan and the others~! Could 
it be that you came to cheer for me!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Urara-chan was trying so hard~☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Today was super fun too! Even though I 
came in dead last, I got to run a whole 
bunch♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Urara-chan is amazing~! Maya 
always pouts whenever she loses☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm having fun all the time! 'Cause I 
absolutely love running!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still... winning is pretty tough, huh! 
Maya-chan, how do you manage to win?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Maya-chan is always super fast, 
isn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe I could win if I became 
like Maya-chan~!
choice_data_list:
Why don't you try doing some joint 
practice?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sounds like a plan☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Let's practice together and win next 
time, Urara-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya and Trainer-chan's racing lecture~☆ 
Our student today is Haru Urara-san♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Right here! It's Urara!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then let's jump right in~! First, a 
question for Trainer-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What does the current Urara-chan need 
right now!?
choice_data_list:
Let's build up your stamina so you don't 
tire out!

Let's figure out the trick to overtaking 
our rivals!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong, correct!☆ That's Maya's Trainer 
for you♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...*Ahem!* Well then, Haru Urara-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
To put it bluntly☆ You totally ran out of 
steam halfway through that last race, 
didn't you!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was fun, but I was completely 
wiped out~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"If you build up more stamina, you'll be 
able to run without totally running out of 
steam~☆"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really! Maya-chan is so smart~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzzt, wrong! Maya is a teacher today, so 
call me "Maya-sensei"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeees, Professor Maya!

And so, under Mayano Top Gun's guidance, 
Haru Urara completed her training—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~☆ Great minds think alike, huh!? Maya 
was thinking the exact same thing~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Urara-chan, how do you usually run?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Always? I'm running with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that so~...? Well, is there 
anything troubling you then?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see~, I'm having trouble moving 
forward~. I feel like I'm gonna bump into 
someone and panic!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oho, I see, I see~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then in the next race, let's try keeping 
our eyes glued straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you just keep looking straight ahead, 
there will come a moment when nobody is in 
front of you—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, I'll just run 
straight ahead with a big whooosh☆

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll give it a try♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Listen, listen! I managed to pass someone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wah, we did it~! Pass one more person—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: By yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! I'll keep passing them one by one 
like this and take 1st place in the end~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep passing everyone until I take 
1st place! I'm gonna win it for suuure!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ooh~!!

Coaching Haru Urara seems to have had a 
positive influence on Mayano Top Gun.
